title: TEMA: DANZA TOBAS PASOS BÁSICOS 1, 2 Y 3

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher stands in a home studio and enthusiastically guides students through basic steps using a prop stick. He breaks down movements slowly and repeats counts while demonstrating.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher greets students and introduces the three basic steps of Tobas.
Teacher reminds students about pre-exercise warmups.

metaphors: El palo representa a la lanza
safety: Primero tengo que hacer un calentamiento previo de 5 a 10 minutos

steps_taught.name: Paso 1
steps_taught.description: Salts and leg lifts with a stick representing a spear.

steps_taught.name: Paso 2
steps_taught.description: Kicks and turns holding a stick.

steps_taught.name: Paso 3
steps_taught.description: Jumps and turns resembling a traditional dance variant.

what_works: Repetition of sequences at different speeds
what_hinders: Demonstration is entirely from the front

quotes.text: Buenos días con todos los alumnos de tercer año A y tercer año B
para hacer cualquier desgaste físico primero tengo que hacer un calentamiento previo

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands holding a stick and talking to the camera.
Teacher demonstrates leg lifts and hopping with a prop stick.
Teacher demonstrates jumping steps while counting aloud.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using a household broom handle as a prop representing a traditional spear during a basic dance tutorial.
